hook: Which position reduces the shown horizontal reach?

recall.question: A cupboard is 60 cm deep. A tray in it slides out 40 cm. How far do you reach for the item at the back of the tray?
recall.why: Sliding brings the rear item forward by the tray's travel: 60 − 40 = 20 cm. The cupboard holds the same amount; only the reach changed.
